patch_model.about: Default patch envelope (galaxy design 7 and 12, stage G0): a Milky-Way-like disc so systems can be formed before any galaxy exists. Closed-form; every number is a pack default with its source. Arms, bar, local texture and events arrive with G4 and G6.

sources.densities: local systems about 0.08 per cubic parsec (RECONS 10 pc census, Henry et al. 2018); thick to thin 0.12 and halo to thin 0.005 at the midplane (Juric et al. 2008)
sources.scale_lengths: thin 2.6 kpc, thick 2.0 kpc; thin 300 pc and thick 900 pc scale heights (Juric et al. 2008; Bland-Hawthorn and Gerhard 2016)
sources.halo: power-law index 2.8 and flattening 0.64 (Juric et al. 2008)
sources.imf: Kroupa 2001, stars only (0.08 to 150 solar masses)
sources.enrichment: ISM [Fe/H] rises as log10 of 1 - exp(-t/tau); present-day gradient -0.06 dex per kpc (Genovali et al. 2014)
sources.alpha_fe: high-alpha plateau with a knee about 1 Gyr after the first stars, from the delay of type Ia supernovae (Matteucci and Francois 1989)
sources.c_o: solar C/O 0.55 (Asplund et al. 2009), rising with [Fe/H] (Nissen et al. 2014)
sources.mg_si: solar Mg/Si 1.2 by number (Asplund et al. 2009); stellar spread from Adibekyan et al. 2015
sources.cluster: embedded cluster masses dN/dM proportional to M^-2 from 10 to 1e5 solar masses (Lada and Lada 2003), so per star proportional to M^-1
sources.fuv: birth-cluster far-ultraviolet field, median about 1000 G0 (Fatuzzo and Adams 2008)
sources.al26: rough: most systems are born with less Al-26 than the Sun had (Gounelle 2015; Lichtenberg et al. 2016). Labelled rough
sources.sfr: Milky Way star formation 1.65 solar masses per year (Licquia and Newman 2015)
sources.ia: type Ia delay-time distribution proportional to 1/t from 40 Myr, 1.3e-3 per solar mass formed (Maoz and Mannucci 2012)
sources.velocity: velocity dispersion proportional to age^0.35, about 50 km/s at 10 Gyr (Holmberg et al. 2009)
sources.rocky: [Fe/H] about -1 as the floor for rocky planets (Johnson and Li 2012)
sources.sterilising: a supernova within 8 pc can strip an ozone layer (Gehrels et al. 2003)
